name: SOURODIP KUNDU
title: Lead Software Engineer
summary: React-focused Lead Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and modernizing enterprise-scale IAM and identity governance platforms, specializing in React.js, TypeScript, Micro Frontends, Node.js, GraphQL, and AWS serverless, recognized for leading large-scale modernization efforts at IBM and driving significant improvements in scalability and maintainability.
about:
I am a passionate and results-driven Lead Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience specializing in building and modernizing enterprise-scale identity and access management (IAM) platforms. My expertise lies in architecting robust frontend solutions using React.js, TypeScript, and Micro Frontends, complemented by strong full-stack capabilities in Node.js, GraphQL, and AWS serverless technologies. I thrive on tackling complex challenges, optimizing system performance, and fostering innovation through AI-assisted engineering.

My professional philosophy centers on delivering high-quality, maintainable, and scalable software solutions that directly impact business objectives. I enjoy leading teams, standardizing best practices, and driving strategic technical initiatives that improve developer productivity and accelerate release cycles. I am constantly exploring new technologies and methodologies to enhance user experience and streamline development workflows, always aiming to deliver impactful solutions.

description: Led UI modernization strategy across IBM ISC and IBM ISIM, migrating from Dojo to React.js and TypeScript with Carbon Design System, reducing front-end technical debt by over 40%.
Defined and implemented enterprise-wide Microfrontend architecture, enabling modular scalability and accelerating release cycles by approximately 30% across IAM modules.
Standardized front-end engineering practices across teams, improving maintainability, reducing duplication, and boosting developer productivity.
Drove AI-assisted engineering transformation, integrating tools like IBM Bob for automated test generation, improving test coverage and reducing manual unit testing effort by 30-40%.
Delivered critical features for IBM Security Verify Governance (ISVG), including Manage Certification and Authorization modules, enhancing enterprise IAM workflow efficiency.
Developed the ARC (Activity Risk Mitigation) module for real-time Segregation of Duties (SoD) and Sensitive Access violation detection, strengthening compliance and reducing security risks.
Modernized legacy Dojo.js-based access workflows by introducing time-bound access controls and native file upload, significantly improving user experience.
Designed and implemented a dynamic Custom Roles framework using TanStack Form, along with i18n and RTL support, reducing configuration effort by approximately 35%.
Developed and integrated REST APIs using TypeScript in a Node.js environment, ensuring seamless integration with front-end systems and improving service scalability.
Led the migration and modernization of legacy Java APIs to TypeScript, optimizing performance and reducing technical debt through detailed analysis and re-engineering.
Designed and implemented new backend capabilities, including AWS DynamoDB audit logging and event tracking via AWS Lambda, enhancing system observability.
Independently enhanced critical features and performed RCA using AWS CloudWatch and Lambda, resolving QA/production incidents and improving system stability.
